spoken: Navy... thank God.

speaker: reyes
text: 나는 레예스. 제작동. 기계들이 우리 라인 사람을 전부 죽였어.
spoken: I'm Reyes. Fabrication. The machines... they killed EVERYONE ON MY LINE.

speaker: reyes
spoken: I need your commander. NOW.

speaker: kessler
text: 4번 초소, 케슬러다. 이 채널에 아무나. 아무나.
spoken: Post 4, this is Kessler... Anyone on this channel. Anyone.
note: rule: U (§4.3 timer); fx: radio (positional at mk5_radio)

speaker: kessler
note: rule: C: radio not taken, player within 12 m of mk5_radio **and in duty5 or ready5** (both rooms have a camera, S6); fx: radio (positional)

speaker: kessler
spoken: This is Commander Kessler... Who is this?

speaker: kessler
text: 피팅을 안 받았군. 게이트 통과하는 거 지켜봤다. 사흘 만에 처음이야, 안 받은 사람은.
spoken: You're not fitted. I watched you come through the gate. You're the first in three days who isn't.

speaker: kessler
text: 문 옆 키패드는 죽어 있다. 여기서 전원을 넣어주지.

speaker: kessler
spoken: Code is... four. Seven. One. Nine.
note: rule: U (pickup; **its end = power cue**; also Q before S)

speaker: kessler
text: 지상으로 가는 케이블은 하나뿐이다. 트렁크. 그것이 그걸 타고 올라가면, 전부 끝이야.
spoken: There's one cable to the surface. The trunk. If that thing gets up it... it's EVERYWHERE.

speaker: kessler
text: 네가 그걸 끊을 거다. 그리고 내가 매 미터마다 안내—
spoken: You're going to cut it. And I'm going to talk you through every metre of it.
note: rule: U; **cut** written by W9 from ASR word times (just after "of"); ST stops the handle there (fade 0.03 s); cut = ASR file time: "of" ends 4.08 s, "it" 4.08-4.32 s, file 4.38 s, lead 0.32 s

speaker: kessler
text: …그래. 그놈이 이 채널의 모든 말을 듣고 있어. 어쩔 수 없어. 그래도 들어.
spoken: Yes... It hears every word on this channel. I can't help that. So listen anyway.

speaker: kessler
text: 여기 내 사람이 넷 있어. 피팅된 상태로. 이 방은 차폐돼 있어. 밖에서는 걔네는 그놈 거야.
spoken: I've four of my people in here. Fitted. This room is shielded... Out there, they're his.

speaker: kessler
text: 문은 못 연다, 레예스. 키패드를 써. 후미로 와, 스파인 끝으로.
note: rule: C: code not yet accepted

speaker: kessler
text: 좋아. 후미로 와, 스파인 끝으로. 문은 못 열어.

speaker: kessler
text: 그 무전기는 브레케 거였어. …알아. 계속 움직여.
spoken: That radio was Brekke's... I know. Keep moving.

speaker: kessler
note: rule: U (Q, before the context line)

speaker: kessler
text: 휠. 서쪽 갤러리, 터널 문 위.

speaker: kessler
text: 터널 문 열렸어. 남서쪽 구석, 바닥 높이. 가.

speaker: kessler
note: rule: C: Q while a hostile is awake within 25 m

speaker: kessler
text: 잠수정 격납고에 움직임. 유닛 둘. 그리고 내 사람 하나. 네 쪽으로 가.
spoken: Movement in the sub bay. Two units. And one of mine... Coming to you.
note: rule: C: g5_spine spawned, player not in sub5, once; queued behind the pickup sequence (scene), dropped if a wave member is already in sight (S7)

speaker: kessler
text: 보트는 잊어. 장교 손바닥으로만 발사돼. 내 것이나 부관의.
note: rule: C: fact l5_boat (palm refused) **or** mk5_launch in view ≤ 4 m for 2 s; radio; once

speaker: kessler
text: 그것들을 달고 오면 안 돼. 처리해. 그다음 돌아와.
note: rule: C: in t5_cmd, phase S, not calm; cooldown 20 s

speaker: kessler
text: 카메라로는 깨끗하다고 나와. 카메라는 걔 거야. 목을 직접 봐야겠어. 내 눈으로.
spoken: The camera says you're clean. The cameras are his... I need to see your neck. With my OWN EYES.

speaker: kessler

speaker: kessler
spoken: Clean... God. Clean.

speaker: kessler
text: 리사. 외데고르. 하겐. 크누센. 사고 때 모듈 근무를 서던 애들이야.
spoken: Risa. Oedegaard. Hagen. Knutsen. They had the module watch when it happened.

speaker: kessler
text: 이 안에서는 아직 걔네 자신이야. 이 문이 열리는 순간, 걔네는 그놈 거야. 그러니 안 열어.
spoken: In here they're still themselves. The second this door opens, they're his. So it doesn't open.

speaker: kessler
text: 순데 박사도 여기 있어. 월요일에 나를 경고하러 올라왔지. 들었어. 나머지는 너무 늦었지만.
spoken: Dr. Sunde's in here too. She came up on Monday to warn me. I listened... Too late for the rest.

speaker: kessler
text: 케이블 터널은 잠수정 격납고 옆이야. 잠금 해제해 뒀어. 유압은 갤러리 휠에서 차단돼 있어, 서쪽.

speaker: kessler
text: 그 문은 어뢰도 견뎌. 탄약 아껴.
note: rule: C: a player bullet hits door5_cmd / the port, radio, once

speaker: kessler
text: 그놈이야. 비상 조명은 하드와이어링이라 그놈이 못 끈다. 이용해.
spoken: That's him. Emergency lighting's hard-wired... He can't take that. Use it.

speaker: kessler
text: 발사 록 통로에 넷. 그중 둘은 내 사람. 가능하면 고지대를 잡아.

speaker: kessler
text: 터널 문 열렸어. 가. 무슨 일이 있어도 멈추지 마.
note: rule: C: phase W, l5_unit_wheel end + 0.4 s, once (S7)

speaker: kessler
spoken: You're in. The head-end is two hundred metres on... I'll be here.
note: rule: C: phase X, 0 hostiles in tunnel5
